finding: The suppress around the mode restore in write_atomic has no test: no test makes os.chmod raise on the failure path.
why: The failure tests raise only from os.replace and Path.unlink. If a change drops that suppress, a failed restore replaces the first error and skips the temp drop, and no test fails.
fix: Add a test where os.replace raises and the restore chmod raises. Assert the replace error reaches the caller and no temp file remains.
